crossRefs.note: Joshua sent men from Jericho to Ai, which is beside Beth Aven, on the east side of Bethel, and spoke to them, saying…
The children of Benjamin also lived from Geba onward, at Michmash and Aija, and at Bethel and its towns,
Saul stayed in the uttermost part of Gibeah under the pomegranate tree which is in Migron: and the people who were with…
Saul chose for himself three thousand men of Israel, of which two thousand were with Saul in Michmash and in the Mount…
The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand…
The one crag rose up on the north in front of Michmash, and the other on the south in front of Geba.
They struck the Philistines that day from Michmash to Aijalon. The people were very faint;

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Michmash
people.line: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory

people.name: Migron
people.line: A place near Gibeah where Saul camped

translations.web: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
translations.bsb: Assyria has entered Aiath and passed through Migron, storing their supplies at Michmash.
translations.kjv: He is come to Aiath, he is passed to Migron; at Michmash he hath laid up his carriages:
translations.asv: He is come to Aiath, he is passed through Migron; at Michmash he layeth up his baggage;
